title: Size-based dynamics of nanoparticles in plant growth and environmental stress tolerance: potential benefits and hazards
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00785B, Critical Review
Sunil Soni, Km Madhuri Singh, Ambuj Bhushan Jha, Rama Shanker Dubey, Pallavi Sharma
Nanoparticle size plays a crucial role in determining their uptake, mobility, and biological effects in plants. Precise control over particle size is thus essential for productive use in agriculture.
